name: History
description: History<Payload>, the one undo history: named steps, a run under one key folded into one step, endRun, undo and redo through an apply closure, jump to a step, step ids that never repeat and dirty read as savedStepID against currentStepID; HistoryReading, what menus and title bars read. EK-2 declares it as a stub that answers like an empty history; EK-8 fills the bodies. HistoryCommands.swift: HistoryListing (the base state, every step's name, the applied index and the saved index) read from a History, the HistoryJumping protocol an app's document conforms to, and HistoryCommands.specs, the History panel's history.read query and history.jump view command; autosave-history AH-1 declares them with ids, schemas and availability, AH-6 fills the bodies.
